metadata.title: Lo-Fi Analog Portrait with Scribble Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white portrait of a shirtless man with arms crossed, featuring a heavy analog halftone texture and a crude, white hand-drawn scribble masking the eyes and forehead. The background includes dark, geometric film-strip borders.
coreVisualRelationships: The white scribble acts as a disruptive mask over the photographic realism
The horizontal dark bar of the film frame intersects the subject's eye line
The coarse halftone grid unifies the photographic and graphic elements
The crossed arms create a protective, closed-off triangular composition
coreInvariants: Shirtless male subject in a centered, mid-shot pose

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white scribble at the top center serves as the primary focal point due to its high contrast against the dark background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the white scribble, moves down the bridge of the nose to the crossed arms, and then follows the dark horizontal film bar across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The background is a textured, dark gray void that emphasizes the subject's silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone gray halftone for the skin and background texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the film borders and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the hand-drawn scribble and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the white scribble and the dark background bar.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Eyes represented by simple black dots within the white scribble
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair with a clean, industrial sans-serif for metadata to contrast the raw scribble.

preserve: The placement of the scribble over the eyes

candidateDirections.reason: To replicate the raw, DIY feel of the eye mask
To complement the analog film aesthetic for secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a black and white, high-contrast portrait of a man with arms crossed, shirtless, with a heavy halftone dot pattern and dark horizontal film-strip bars crossing the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a white digital brush with a rough, chalky texture, draw a crude scribble mask over the subject's eyes, including two simple black dots for eyes within the white mass.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern visible and consistent?
Does the white scribble effectively mask the eyes?
Are the film-strip borders present and dark?

mustRedesign: Any specific brand names on the film borders
The specific facial features of the original subject
The exact shape of the original scribble
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the halftone does not look like digital noise.
Verify the scribble looks hand-drawn, not computer-generated.
Check that the black levels are deep and crushed.
Confirm the composition remains centered and balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast B&W photo + Apply a coarse halftone filter + Overlay a crude white hand-drawn mask over the eyes + Frame with dark geometric bars.
